components.css: .ds-sign { background: #20262c; color: #fff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 18px 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,19,23,.10), 0 14px 30px -16px rgba(15,19,23,.45); } .ds-sign-word { font-family: Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', sans-serif; font-size: 46px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1.12; } .ds-sign-rule { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #00b453; margin: 16px 0 14px; } .ds-sign-hanja { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffd166; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-sign-en { color: #b3bcc5; }

components.name: The line
components.description: Home's study track: stations around the current unit, the rail filled to here.
components.css: .ds-line { list-style: none; display: flex; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-line li { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; color: #59626b; position: relative; } .ds-line li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 13px; right: 50%; width: 100%; height: 6px; background: #cdebd8; } .ds-line li:first-child::before { display: none; } .ds-line li.done::before, .ds-line li.here::before { background: #00a84d; } .ds-line i { position: relative; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 5px 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #f1f3f2; border: 5px solid #cdebd8; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-line .done i { background: #00a84d; border-color: #00a84d; } .ds-line .here i { width: 32px; height: 32px; margin: 0; border: 6px solid #00a84d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #f1f3f2, 0 0 0 5.5px #14181c; } .ds-line .here span { color: #14181c; font-weight: 800; }

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #dde1e3; } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 0 6px; font-size: 10.5px; color: #59626b; } .ds-tabs svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tabs a.on { color: #14181c; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tabs a.on svg { stroke: #007a37; } .ds-tabs a.on::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; left: 28%; right: 28%; height: 3px; border-radius: 0 0 3px 3px; background: #00a84d; }

narrative.overview: Seoul Metro and MTR wayfinding: the study track is a line of stations and every study card is a station sign, the word in heavy white gothic over its hanja in signage yellow and its meaning. Each app owns one line colour. Calm and grown-up, light by day and charcoal by night, with the standard iPhone controls left standard.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal station signs for every card
The study track drawn as a line

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: An app uses its own line colour and no other accent; status colours appear only where they mean a grade, a tone or a result.

rules.name: The Sign Rule
rules.body: Inside a sign, colour tokens are re-pointed so anything placed on it takes the sign's palette.

dos: Do put every study card on a sign.
Do keep the grade row reachable without scrolling.
Do draw icons as SVG or masks.
donts: Don't box examples inside a sign in a second panel.
Don't add a second accent colour to an app.
Don't put emoji or glyphs in labels as icons.
Don't restyle the Mongolian app from this system.
Don't set body text in Pretendard; it is one heavy weight for names only.
